(4) Housing issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless it is a mobilehome. (5) Residential property alienable separate from title to any other dwelling unit, such as single-family homes and condominiums. This exemption applies only if the owner is not a REIT, a corporation, or an LLC with at least one corporate member, and the tenant was given the required written exemption notice (§ 1947.12(d)(5)).
